name: ng18_16_draft_flag
description: A preview (real = 0) road piece on a bridge step (cell flags 0x40001) has 0x80000000, keeps the type and bridge bits and gets 0x4000: 0x80044001. The committed piece (real = 1) has 0x80000000 cleared: 0x44001. A tunnel occupant is made usable (0x10000000) with 0x4000 cleared. [inferred] Draft mode keeps the type bits and 0xC0000 of the cell flags.
